dialogues.speaker: Yolo
dialogues.text: That's right! Every piece of graffiti has a soul, just like how every woven scroll contains its own legend.

dialogues.speaker: Yolo
dialogues.text: You should know, in the distant past, this was more than just a metaphor — there was once a group of mystics who could infuse shades and hues with the power of the Wayob. They used graffiti to protect Natlan from great calamities.

dialogues.speaker: Yolo
dialogues.text: We might not have that sort of power anymore, but all art possesses an intrinsic soul.

dialogues.speaker: Yolo
dialogues.text: Different minerals, petals, and even saurian scales lend unique colors to the pigments they create — this is the "soul" of graffiti.

dialogues.speaker: Yolo
dialogues.text: Why don't you try it out for yourself? Don't worry about getting it on your clothes. This is graffiti, the whole point is to have fun!
